task.target: Used primary bank or credit union in-person branch during pastmonth

input_units.branch_present: ZIP branch present Q12024 binary author-derived
input_units.branch_closed: ZIP net branch decrease2019Q4–2024Q1 binary author-derived

task.timing_contract: Contemporaneous self-reported channels; ZIP branch access covariates from source linked records. Association, no causal digital substitution or closure effect.
task.calibration: Three whole regions leave-one-region-out development; hash-reserved fourth region, no target calibration.
task.independent_unit: Respondents nested in four Census regions. Only one held region: within-survey regional transfer, no population-level precision.
task.scope_limits: Complete-case banked adult survey with positive WEIGHT_FINAL; WEIGHT_ALT is not used. Region-balanced survey-weighted risk is not national prevalence. DK/refused/skipped are exclusions, not non-use. Geographic author-derived indicators are not measured travel distance.

exposure.schema: Schema and source codebook aggregate tabulations inspected; no reserved respondent target or confirmation metric inspected. Source-aware public survey.

task.uncertainty_policy: Whole-group errors/ranges; no row bootstrap or manufactured independent-population confidence. Confirmation becomes exposed after freeze.

selection: Minimize group-balanced primary error; prefer fewer coefficients within1percent of minimum; baseline may win.
stopping: At least5distinct scientific hypotheses, adaptive to development evidence; stop after2consecutive substantive attempts without accuracy/robustness/interpretation gain.
